vocabulary.definition: a Palestinian uprising against Israeli occupation
vocabulary.example: The intifada in the early 2000s resulted in significant unrest in the region.

vocabulary.definition: intrude on a person's territory or rights
vocabulary.example: The new construction project will encroach on the wildlife sanctuary.

vocabulary.definition: strong wire with barbs at regular intervals used to make fences or barriers
vocabulary.example: The prison perimeter was secured with barbed wire to prevent escapes.

vocabulary.definition: a group of people sent to keep watch over an area
vocabulary.example: The patrols discovered a hidden path used by smugglers.

vocabulary.definition: a portion of territory within or surrounded by a larger territory
vocabulary.example: The embassy was located in a diplomatic enclave in the capital city.
The rebels used tunnels to move supplies without being detected.
